name: luminedge-workspace
description: The Luminedge design system and component library workspace.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @luminedge/tools && npm run build -w @luminedge/components && npm run build -w @luminedge/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @luminedge/docs
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @luminedge/docs
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run check -w @luminedge/docs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
